description_en: Floor 3 157.000 € Super cases December 21 near Hotel Mondial, by the road, 2 Apartments 1+1 for sale. The 3rd floor of the new residential building with an elevator. WITH MORTGAGE. Gross area 55 m2 and 53 m2. 7-storey building, 3 entrances per floor. Entrance from the main road. Staircase with natural light. Dressed with capot system. Totally reconstructed, new doors and windows, new hydraulic and electrical system, suspended ceilings, laid with parquet, tiled, etc.... Ready for habitation. Very suitable for business activities. Facing south west. A good opportunity, both for housing and for investments
